leadText:
Let's Get Started (Hindi: लेट्स गेट स्टार्टेड Let's Get Started, Tamil: லெட்ஸ் கெட் ஸ்டார்டெட் Let's Get Started, Telugu: లెట్స్ గెట్ స్టార్టెడ్ Let's Get Started, Bengali: লেটস গেট স্টারটেড Let's Get Started) is the opening theme for the dubs of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It was used from The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two), replacing . Boom Kaboom is used as the corresponding ending theme.

The opening animation has multiple versions that use the same footage as the corresponding English opening themes, Becoming Me and My Favorite Pokémon (which thmeselves use clips from the corresponding Japanese opening themes, Heart-Pounding Diary, Halo, and ).

The song was composed by the Indian music duo with lyrics by the duo , and vocals by singer in the Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu versions, and by uncredited artists in the Bengali versions. The song was first unveiled at a press conference announcing the premiere of . A music video of the full version of the song was uploaded to the Disney India YouTube channel on May 24, 2024, and a sing-along video was uploaded to the official Pokémon YouTube channels on December 5, 2025.

It was used from The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two), replacing . Boom Kaboom is used as the corresponding ending theme.

The opening animation has multiple versions that use the same footage as the corresponding English opening themes, Becoming Me and My Favorite Pokémon (which thmeselves use clips from the corresponding Japanese opening themes, Heart-Pounding Diary, Halo, and ).

The song was composed by the Indian music duo with lyrics by the duo , and vocals by singer in the Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu versions, and by uncredited artists in the Bengali versions. The song was first unveiled at a press conference announcing the premiere of . A music video of the full version of the song was uploaded to the Disney India YouTube channel on May 24, 2024, and a sing-along video was uploaded to the official Pokémon YouTube channels on December 5, 2025.

==Opening animation==
===Version 1 (HZ001 - HZ025)===
====Synopsis====
Liko holds her pendant before letting go, causing it to glow brightly as the camera zooms out. Roy holds one of the ancient adventurer's Poké Balls, gazing up at the clear sky surrounded by clouds. Liko and Roy lay down on the battlefield, exhausted as and come to their sides and they exchange a laugh. Mollie is in the nursery with , , , , and , turning around in her chair as Chansey carries a tray to the opposite end of the room. In the kitchen, Murdock's fills a bowl with cream as Murdock and are ready to make something out of it. Friede enters the Captain's deck to check on Captain Pikachu and . In one of her videos, Nidothing and dance and get up close to the camera. Charizard and Cap watch as Amethio orders to attack while Liko and Sprigatito clash with Roy and Fuecoco. Liko and Sprigatito are shown together outside the observation room, enjoying the breeze. The logo appears in front of all the Rising Volt Tacklers walking together ahead of the Brave Olivine.

aiReadySummary.title: Let's Get Started
aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Let's Get Started
Category:Telugu opening themes
Let's Get Started (Hindi: लेट्स गेट स्टार्टेड Let's Get Started, Tamil: லெட்ஸ் கெட் ஸ்டார்டெட் Let's Get Started, Telugu: లెట్స్ గెట్ స్టార్టెడ్ Let's Get Started, Bengali: লেটস গেট স্টারটেড Let's Get Started) is the opening theme for the dubs of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It was used from The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two), replacing . Boom Kaboom is used as the corresponding ending theme.

The opening animation has multiple versions that use the same footage as the corresponding English opening themes, Becoming Me and My Favorite Pokémon (which thmeselves use clips from the corresponding Japanese opening themes, Heart-Pounding Diary, Halo, and ).

The song was composed by the Indian music duo with lyrics by the duo , and vocals by singer in the Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu versions, and by uncredited artists in the Bengali versions. The song was first unveiled at a press conference announcing the premiere of . A music video of the full version of the song was uploaded to the Disney India YouTube channel on May 24, 2024, and a sing-along video was uploaded to the official Pokémon YouTube channels on December 5, 2025.
